title: ValueError: invalid literal for int() on empty analytics query parameter
description: When dashboard filters submit an empty query string 'GET /api/analytics/orders?days=', the backend crashes with a 500 error instead of defaulting to 30 days.
error_log:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'app/services/analytics_service.py', line 13, in parse_date_range_days
    return int(raw_param)
ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: ''
recent_changes: Commit f1029c: Added custom date filtering on sales analytics
expected_behavior: Empty string or whitespace should fall back to default_days
actual_behavior: Throws ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: ''
